scene: Mario Bros Circuit start grid, kart idle, race running; profiled with EDEN_NX2_GPU_PROFILE, per-title Low accuracy + async shaders, split inactive (new default), binary ae94c24e
key_findings: GPU command thread is saturated (~99% busy, idle 9 ms/s): it is THE bottleneck at Low accuracy
Fence host waits are 0 ms/s at Low accuracy (were 235 ms/s at High): that cost is already harvested by the Low setting
Command processing (macro+method+dma dispatch) = ~574 ms/s = 57% of the thread
Draw preparation = ~250 ms/s for ~1900 draws/frame at ~20 FPS
61% of 3D register writes are same-value (1.92M of 3.16M per second)
The GPU split should parallelize 574 vs 370 ms/s but measured -8 to -17%: root-cause candidates are the 1335 semaphore acquires/s each draining the backend, and the condvar wake protocol
next_optimization_targets_ranked: 1. Fix split-mode overhead (drain-per-acquire serialization, wake protocol) to parallelize the saturated thread: largest theoretical win (+50%+)
2. Reduce per-call dispatch cost of method (65 ns) and macro paths against upstream
3. Batch draw preparation lookups (read handles / fill image views / bind) across the ~1900 draws per frame
4. Startup: 20k pipeline rebuild takes ~240 s per boot; consider persisting translated SPIR-V
